**What are you proposing?**
A clear description of the feature, transformation, provider, or
tooling change you'd like to see.

**Which part of the project does this touch?**
ITRO / SPECTRE / verification / providers / website / docs

**Why is this useful?**
What problem does it solve, or what research question does it help
answer? If this relates to one of the items in
[Research directions](Readme.md#research-directions), mention which one.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.

**Additional context**
Links, references, or related work.
